summary: API regression passed for registration, scoped demo data, CRUD persistence, analytics, password reset, TOTP enable/login challenge, cookies, and unauthenticated protection. Live landing and CTA passed, but the browser registration flow intermittently remained on the dashboard loading screen despite a backend 200 response.

integration_issues.issue: After successful registration and navigation to /app, UI remained on 'Loading your overview…' and the critical flow could not continue. Backend trace showed POST /api/auth/register 200 and GET /api/dashboard 200, suggesting a frontend state/render race or unhandled response issue.

action_items: Reproduce registration in browser and fix the intermittent Overview loading state; inspect Overview data state and render errors after /api/dashboard 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend build has React hook dependency warnings in RecordsPage (load/search effects).
Password reset link targets /reset-password but App has no explicit /reset-password route; console development-token flow works only through the auth page's internal reset mode.
seed_data_creation: Created unique TEST/UI test users with demo records; records remain scoped to those users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API flow is green. UI landing/CTA and registration submit work, but the first browser run stayed at Overview loading even though backend returned dashboard 200. Browser console showed repeated auth/me 401s before registration, then no JS exception.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open landing, click hero CTA, submit a valid unique registration, wait for /app. Shell renders but Overview remains Loading your overview. Backend logs show register 200, dashboard 200. Likely frontend timing/state or render issue; needs browser reproduction with network/React inspection.
